posts.content_md:
Howdy All,

I put up some pictures of my first good hologram, here:

[http://www.ajaxelectronics.com/optics_i ... graphy.htm](http://www.ajaxelectronics.com/optics_info/holography/holography.htm)

Subject: A pile of dice (including a hidden 5th die, behind the obvious 4)

Reflection Hologram, 25sec exposure, ~20mW HeNe

Integraf PFG-03M Plate, JD4 Developer

Illumination: Hi-intensity 630nM LED

This was actually my 7th try, the previous ones were either underexposed or the plate moved. After this good one, though, I'm hooked! I have a big list of things to "Holograph" so hopefully I'll have some more good ones to post here soon!

Thanks,

-Andy C.
